summary: Added a subtract(a, b) pure function to backend/app.py alongside the existing add(a, b) function, plus a unit test suite covering positive, negative, and zero-value cases for both operations.
notes: No database contract was available; this task is a pure arithmetic utility function with no persistence needs, so no data model was introduced.
Recreated backend/app.py with the existing add(a, b) function (assumed implementation: return a + b) since no prior file content was provided, then appended subtract(a, b) in the same minimal style.
Added test_app.py using the standard library unittest module to avoid introducing new dependencies, covering positive, negative, zero, and mixed-sign cases for both add and subtract.
